scope: Read-only audit of the published CI run; no re-execution and no change to accepted references or tolerances.

evidence.archiveDigestStatus: GitHub-reported digests retained; archives downloaded/extracted by gh, not independently rehashed as ZIP archives

inferenceChangeMeaning: TensorNodeTests changes the expected registered catalogue node count from 25 to 26; this is a count assertion change, not a style-only edit. Inference calculations, fixtures and the normal CI workflow are unchanged in the compared scope.
limits: 55 new application tests pass per OS. The 18 Autogrow source-reference tests added after this commit are not part of this run.
First-use, checkpoint and pipeline contract processes overlap the ordinary suite; their counts must not be added as unique coverage.
Windows and Linux stopped before the aggregate Inference suite and the stock CLIP process. macOS ran both and failed two stock CLIP comparisons.
CPU identity and .NET intrinsic availability are observations, not proof of ATen or oneDNN/MKL primitive dispatch.
Native payload identities were recorded after calculation and cached at first observation per process. They are not before/after loader integrity controls.
macOS native module enumeration returned unavailable. Successful execution is not substituted for a binary identity assertion.
No dedicated CFG output trace was enabled in this workflow. Its failures are attested by TRX assertions; independent payload analysis covers U-Net, Euler and pipeline traces.
U-Net coarse traces retain latent identity and ten outputs, not all actual input/parameter bytes or primitive inputs. They cannot isolate one primitive cause.
Windows hardware, managed assemblies, process allocation and launch context were not controlled as a same-host experiment against the previous run.
The failure remains an acceptance failure. No backend profile, reference replacement, native bundle adoption or tolerance adjustment is authorized by this audit.
